SELECT 'booking' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status!='confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status!='delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'booking' AS kind,json_object('id',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'status',b.status,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'reference',b.client_reference,'cancel',(SELECT json_group_array(step) FROM customer_events ce WHERE ce.request_id=b.request_id),'charge',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status!='confirmed' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins ci WHERE ci.booking_id=b.booking_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'event',json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.status,b.client_reference,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,c.created_step,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('kind',ce.kind,'step',ce.step)) FROM customer_events ce WHERE ce.request_id=b.request_id) AS customer_events FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending' ORDER BY b.booking_id
